meta.title: Life Insurance Coverage Estimator | Achieve-style demo
meta.description: Illustrative DIME-style estimate of term life coverage need. Not a quote, offer, or recommendation.

header.title: Coverage need estimator
header.intro: Illustrative estimate of how much term life coverage you might consider based on income replacement, debts, final expenses, and existing coverage. This is not a quote, offer, or recommendation.

demoBanner.strong: Illustrative only — not a quote or underwriting decision.
demoBanner.body: Uses a simple DIME-style heuristic (Debt, Income, Mortgage/debts, Education + final expenses − assets/existing cover). Actual needs and premiums vary widely; talk to a licensed professional for advice.

termYears.label: Preferred term length (informational)
termYears.hint: Term length does not change the coverage-need math in this demo; it is shown for planning context only.
